design_philosophy: Swiss & High-Contrast. Strict grid hierarchy, pure functional beauty. Color is function only. 95% monochrome UI, with vibrant accents guiding action.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Strict grid hierarchy. Generous padding inside containers, tight gaps between widgets.
spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use 1px subtle borders (border-zinc-200) on cards. No heavy shadows, use sharp edges or max 8px radius. Flat backgrounds.

navigation.style: Solid background (white) with right border (1px solid border-zinc-200). Active links highlighted with primary blue left border.
navigation.header: Sticky top bar, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, bottom border.

cards.style: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-md shadow-sm. Hover: -translate-y-[1px] shadow-md border-zinc-300 transition-all duration-200.

buttons.primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-[#00227A] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002FA7]/50
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-zinc-600 hover:text-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-100 rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors

data_visualization.charts: Shadcn Recharts components. Use mono-color (primary blue) for lines/bars unless indicating status (red/yellow).
data_visualization.knowledge_graph: Use React Force Graph 3D or similar for visual network map, set transparent background to blend with white card surface, nodes in primary blue and dark grey.

interactive_elements.shadcn_usage: Extensively use Shadcn UI (Tabs, Dialogs, Select, Tables, Dropdown Menu). Customize radius to 'rounded-md' and replace default focus rings with primary blue.

animations.entrance: staggered fade-in-up (framer-motion) for list items and cards

image_urls.description: Abstract black and white network nodes, used for hero/login area or empty states in graph visualization.
Professional corporate avatar for user profile dropdown.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Text on primary blue must be pure white.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI primitives.
Follow the layout strictly: A collapsible left sidebar + a top header + main content area.
Use the exact fonts: Cabinet Grotesk for Headings, IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the Analytics Dashboard: dense data, 1px borders, white cards on very light grey background.
For the Knowledge Graph visualization, implement a placeholder canvas or utilize an actual charting library (like react-force-graph if possible) mimicking network nodes.
For the Data Source Connectors Panel, use grid layout showing tiles of tools (Slack, GitHub, Drive, WhatsApp, Email) with Phosphor Icons and connection status toggles.
Use the provided image URLs for the user profile and decorative backgrounds where applicable.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover and focus states defined in guidelines.
